name: bugprint
description: MCP server that turns recorded user sessions (rrweb) into failing reproduction tests, verifies they fail the same way, and shrinks them to the essential steps.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate fixtures/checkout-bug.json -o tests/repro/checkout.spec.ts --base-url http://localhost:4173 && node dist/cli.js verify tests/repro/checkout.spec.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.demo:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate fixtures/checkout-bug.json -o tests/repro/checkout-live.spec.ts --base-url http://localhost:4173 --no-mock-network && node dist/cli.js verify tests/repro/checkout-live.spec.ts
scripts.demo:minimize: npm run build && node dist/cli.js minimize fixtures/checkout-bug.json --base-url http://localhost:4173 -o tests/repro/checkout.min.spec.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
